wiki_text: The Manzanillo LNG import terminal is served by the floating storage and regasification unit (FSRU) Energos Freeze (125,000 m3), which berthed at the marine terminal at Pepillo Salcedo (Manzanillo), Montecristi province, on 1 September 2025 under a charter relet by New Fortress Energy to Energia 2000. The first LNG cargo arrived on 8 January 2026 aboard the carrier LNGShips Empress (about 50,000 m3, transferred ship-to-ship to the FSRU for operational testing). A second cargo (about 75,000 m3 from Trinidad and Tobago, carrier BW Pavillon Aranthera) arrived in April 2026. Regasified gas is piped to the adjacent Manzanillo Power Land combined-cycle plant (414 MW), which entered operation around 20 February 2026 and was inaugurated by President Luis Abinader on 27 March 2026. The earlier-flagged risk that NFE's financial distress could disrupt the project did not interrupt FSRU service: NFE entered a debt-restructuring process in early 2026 while the Energos Freeze continued operating at Manzanillo.
